title: Full-coordinate Fourier weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{\\pm1\\}^n$, and let $U$ be a set of coordinates. When all coordinates are free, the restricted Fourier weight indexed by the part of $U$ in the free coordinates equals the square of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $U$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
